## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` (`SimpleObjectForm`: `sectionFieldNames.includes` and the three-key `merged.visibleOn` / `colSpan` / `span` copy, both on objectui `origin/main` `d999617`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the default `object-form` arm resolves section members with its own filter instead of the shared section builder the other five arms use (`buildSectionFields` / `normalizeSectionField`). Two symptoms of that one mechanism: members come out in pool order, and every section-entry override except `visibleOn` / `colSpan` / `span` is dropped — so an authored `required: true` is not enforced on the default arm. **#10476 is folded into this card** (same file, same mechanism); its evidence is carried here. An unenforced `required` ⇒ p2.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T06:47Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main` `d999617`. Dedupe by this seat over 739 objectui cards (open, plus closed since 2026-09-18): `SimpleObjectForm` → 4 hits (this card; #10476, folded here; #8725, a different section-shape card; #9779, closed); `normalizeSectionField` → 3 (this card; #10476; #10254, closed, the source).

### Execution notes

1. The default arm builds sections through the same builder as the other five: the section's authored order, and the full override set (`label`, `required`, `readonly`, `hidden`, `helpText`, `placeholder`, `options`, `min` / `max`, `widget`, `visibleWhen` then `visibleOn`, `colSpan`, `span`). Keep objectui#9884's intersection (a name the pool lacks is dropped, with its warning).
2. Only LAYOUT and per-entry overrides move; values, create defaults and the submitted set stay pool-driven (objectui#9884).
3. Pins, on all six arms: a two-member section in reverse pool order renders in the section's order; `label`, `required` and `visibleWhen` on a section entry take effect.
